verdict.summary: The orchestrator P1 and language-scoped semantic patches are integrated without discarding the sixth-state watchdog, cancellation, or bounded telemetry work. Ten of ten frozen documents materialized 30 of 30 artifacts, and EPUBCheck, Ace, Chromium spine smoke, and the independent package scan passed every artifact. Publication remains blocked: all ten documents require review, aggregate unresolved or ambiguous corrupting joins increased from 157 to 348, semantic tables remain 3 of 87, and native reader evidence is unavailable.

changes: same-identity retry without downgrading an existing passed receipt
pipelined conversion, validators, checkpoint verification, and publication
global conversion maximum of two with exporter document concurrency fixed at one per shard
parent-owned Chromium extraction scratch with symlink and regular-directory checks
pinned offline SCOWL, Hunspell affix, and US English TeX hyphenation data
en and en-US language scope only
exact same-document hard-hyphen and complete unhyphenated-word evidence
shared line, region, float, column, page, bibliography, and source-replay call-chain integration
fail-closed unsupported language and unproved source behavior
redistribution license and source README retained beside the pinned lexicon assets

revised.producerBehavior: The producer patch was relative to the earlier baseline.
revised.revision: Merged manually into the sixth state and retained bounded resource telemetry, 30-second progress watchdogs, cooperative yields, abort propagation, cleanup, and final source and toolchain identity checks.
revised.reason: Blind replacement would have discarded validated sixth-state cancellation and telemetry behavior.

revised.producerBehavior: A joined-word and hard-hyphen collision was recorded as generic unresolved, and downstream structural classification collapsed ambiguity back to unresolved.
revised.revision: Added an explicit ambiguous outcome, preserved it through structural classification, and counted ambiguous plus unresolved outcomes as publication-blocking across completeness, decision records, audit, and private-fidelity validation.
revised.reason: Remove, preserve, ambiguous, unresolved, and structural outcomes must remain distinguishable and replayable.

revised.producerBehavior: Valid pinned spelling and split evidence still required narrow wrap geometry.
revised.revision: An exact complete lowercase occurrence elsewhere in the same document may establish source proof only under the supported language model; the pinned spelling and split point must still pass, and hard-hyphen ambiguity still preserves the source form.
revised.reason: This reduced the first integrated frozen result from 407 to 348 corrupting joins without authorizing geometry-only deletion.

revised.producerBehavior: The synthetic dehyphenation fixture had no PDF language metadata and therefore correctly failed closed.
revised.revision: Added explicit en-US catalog metadata to the repository-owned fixture and updated its source, contract, and manifest hashes.
revised.reason: The fixture now proves language-scoped deletion rather than depending on implicit English or geometry alone.

revised.producerBehavior: Heavy child-process tests used Vitest's five-second outer default, a concurrent-start assertion imposed wall-clock ordering, and a stress probe raced a disappearing progress node.
revised.revision: Added bounded 15-second outer allowances to the known heavy tests, asserted set equality for the two concurrently started jobs while retaining deterministic report equality, and made the terminal progress-node read fail-soft before the next required status check.
revised.reason: The evidence harness and stress test now measure the intended contracts without race-dependent false failures.

rejected.change: Baseline-relative overwrite of the sixth orchestrator and exporter state.
rejected.reason: It would lose validated cancellation, watchdog, resource telemetry, and cleanup changes.

rejected.change: Visible-hyphen deletion from geometry, suffixes, bibliography position, implicit English, unsupported language, or paper identifiers.
rejected.reason: The semantic integration must be language-scoped, generalized, and fail-closed.

rejected.change: Treating ambiguity as a successful removal or preservation.
rejected.reason: The source form must remain visible and the boundary must remain publication-blocking.

rejected.change: Speculative semantic-table heuristics from aggregate receipts.
rejected.reason: The producer supplied no line-level detector evidence for a generalized safe rule, so the table chain remains unchanged.
All ten frozen documents remain review-required and multiple fidelity gates fail.

semanticTables.reason: No generalized table change was supported by retained line-level evidence.
